description: Tabela dinâmica: UF × ativo, soma e % da linha, com totais (ROLLUP).
sql:
WITH "v" AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM READ_PARQUET('Vendas.parquet')
), "p" AS (
  SELECT
    CASE WHEN GROUPING("uf") = 1 THEN '(Total)' ELSE CAST("uf" AS TEXT) END AS "uf",
    CAST(SUM("quantidade") FILTER(WHERE
      CAST("ativo" AS TEXT) = 'true') AS BIGINT) AS "verdadeiro · Qtd",
    CAST(CAST(SUM("quantidade") FILTER(WHERE
      CAST("ativo" AS TEXT) = 'true') AS BIGINT) AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(CAST(SUM("quantidade") AS BIGINT), 0) AS "verdadeiro · % linha",
    CAST(SUM("quantidade") FILTER(WHERE
      CAST("ativo" AS TEXT) = 'false') AS BIGINT) AS "falso · Qtd",
    CAST(CAST(SUM("quantidade") FILTER(WHERE
      CAST("ativo" AS TEXT) = 'false') AS BIGINT) AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(CAST(SUM("quantidade") AS BIGINT), 0) AS "falso · % linha"
  FROM "v"
  GROUP BY
    ROLLUP (
      "uf"
    )
  ORDER BY
    GROUPING("uf"),
    "uf"
)
SELECT
  *
FROM "p"
